PURPOSE: Possession-less credential use for AI agents: scoped agent identity + placeholder-substitution injection at a trusted egress boundary + secret-free audit + revocation cascade. Required before remote executors (Hermes/Codex-style workers, proofs 9-14) touch real credentials.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: A possession-less credential lease: CredentialLease{lease_id, agent_id, credential_refs (names only), service_allowlist (host+path patterns), expires_at, revoked} evaluated at a single trusted egress boundary that maps refs to values at request time. PING's capability-kernel can say 'agent A may call API B' but cannot say 'agent A may USE credential K without ever POSSESSING K'. Agent-vault proves the minimal sufficient four-part shape: scoped bearer token (identity-bound, expiring, cascade-revocable) + boundary placeholder substitution (surface-scoped, fail-closed, injected-always-wins) + secret-free audit (refs not values) + revocation cascade to tokens the agent minted.
